data.name: BitRoca
data.detailed_description:
Bitroca is a decentralized sandbox where every action has a cost. In a world where resources are protected by high-level encryption, your success depends on your ability to process the environment around you. To break a tile, you don't just click—you allocate.

The Cost of Creation:

Unlike traditional builders, Bitroca utilizes a unique Resource Processing Mechanic. Every tile in the world requires a "Proof of Effort" to dismantle or craft. This isn't just a timer; it is a real-time calculation performed by your rig, simulating the raw energy required to reshape a digital frontier.

Key Features:

The Power Grid: You are in total control of your hardware. A small fraction of your CPU is designated to calculate the broken tiles within the main mining world. This only applies to real world cost in breaking a tile, and no other time. Despite this, there are other ways to progress without this implementation

Anti-Bot Ecosystem: Because every tile has a physical processing cost, the economy is naturally shielded from automated bots. In Bitroca, every item in your inventory represents a genuine moment of effort.

Decentralized Discovery: Explore a vast, player-driven world where the ledger is written by the community. Your "work" contributes to the stability and history of the realm.

Physics-Based Sandbox: Build, destroy, and trade in a world that respects the laws of digital thermodynamics.

Technical Note for Players: Bitroca uses a custom background-threading system to handle tile-encryption logic. This system is strictly in-game, contains no blockchain or cryptocurrency elements, and does not communicate with external financial networks. Your hardware works for you, and only for your progress within Bitroca.

data.short_description: Grab a pickaxe and stake your claim. Bitroca is a sandbox survival MMO where your machine fuels every swing, every wall, every win. Mine, build, defend, and trade on a living frontier where the power of the players shapes what the world can become.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 ghz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGl 3.3-compatible (Intel HD 4000 or nwer)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Online-only multiplayer-inter connection required

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur
  • Processor: Apple Silicon M1
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Online-only multiplayer — internet connection required
